approvers: Contracts manager, site project manager, main contractor or developer
reason: I am a glazing man and my worry is a coating sitting on coated glass and frames for months and then marking or staining them when it comes off. We do not buy this today, and a new budget line plus a new supplier is a hard sell when we can use film and tape.
objection: In July and August half the facade is in full sun. Can it be applied and cured, and will it peel off cleanly months later without leaving residue or marking low-E coatings, anodised or PVC frames? If it does mark them, I carry the cost.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape, and make the other trades clean up after themselves. Absorb the occasional scratched pane as a cost.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from another glazing contractor on a Maltese summer job, plus written confirmation from the glass and frame manufacturers that it is compatible with their coatings and does not void warranty.
